subject: integration
name: Load from Orivon's IPFS node
summary: Loads a name's IPFS record through Orivon's node on this computer. Every block is checked against its CID; an IPNS record against its key's signature and the newest sequence seen. Nothing checks that a record is the newest: a lookup service (name.web3.storage) can answer with an older signed one, and the first valid answer wins. A DNS name's DNSLink is read over unauthenticated DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare, Google). Level 3, not 4, because of those two reads. Not private: those servers see the IPNS key or DNS name. Judged here by its publisher.
